title: Carelink follower
body:
The data source "Carelink follower" is not working, It has been 2 hours since the error shown in the image below.

@Navid200 @jamorham 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c19187c7-d21f-4b14-ac09-af3d1e1142ae)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0f319d2b-6a24-4d5c-8bbd-12467668bd72)

comments.body: Same issue here, I am currently looking into it but would appreciate if others look into this as well :) My findings are: - The login url (https://mdtlogin-ocl.medtronic.com:443/mmcl/auth/oauth/v2/token) currently responds to the TLS ClientHello with an TCP close immediately, maybe they block traffic without certain flags? - sniffing on traffic from the iOS app, this domain is not connected to, instead the following are being connected to: clcloud.minimed.eu, carelink.minimed.eu, carelink-connect.minimed.eu, carelink-login.minimed.eu. See the attached screenshot (ignore the 1password stuff)

I also suspect, that the config for Medtronic's endpoints (https://clcloud.minimed.eu/connect/carepartner/v11/discover/android/3.2) is outdated and a new one is loaded by the apps. I will have to disassemble the newest android app to check if a new url is used.

Note that https://clcloud.minimed.com/connect/carepartner/v11/discover/android/3.2 currently reports the SSOConfiguration https://carelink.minimed.eu/configs/v1/eu_sso_cp_eu_v6.json (for EU at least) which references "mdtlogin-ocl.medtronic.com" (which replies with an RST,ACK on ClientHello). This json also says `"client_cert_rsa_keybits": 1024` so maybe the Apps have an mTLS client certificate which the server expects and verifies (which would be very shitty of medtronic) but I think the client cert is not reported in ClientHello so that is unlikely
Update the Android app has a new discovery URL embedded in the APK but the sso configuration seems to be faulty too: https://clcloud.minimed.com/connect/carepartner/v13/discover/android/3.6
Update: This discovery says to use Auth0SSOConfiguration Which actually uses "carelink-login.minimed.eu", so a bit success!

Please don't open an issue in this repository.  
We ask everyone to open a discussion instead.

You must have seen this same request and you must have ignored it or missed it.  
I am going to convert this to a discussion to be fair to everyone else who respects or does not miss that request.
